Common questions

I did not get a sign-in code.

Check your spam folder, then tap Resend code. Codes come from no-reply@lnkd.world and expire after one hour. Use the email shown in your Block account.

How do I change a saved session?

Open the session from Progress, then use its menu to edit it. When you finish a session, only logged sets are saved.

How do I change units or plates?

Open Settings with the sliders at the top right of Today, Plan, or Progress. Set Weight to lb or kg. Your gym holds the plates and bars you use.

How do I cancel or restore Pro?

Open Settings > Block Pro. Manage subscription opens Apple's subscription settings. Restore purchases restores a purchase to the Block account you are signed in to. See Pro pricing and features.

How do I delete my account?

Open Settings > Delete account. This removes your account and all training data. It does not cancel a Block Pro subscription. Cancel the subscription separately in your Apple Account settings.

My assistant cannot read my log.

Connected assistants need Block Pro. Check the signed-in account and your Pro access, then follow the connection checks.
